rule: V7 is the single final destination. Professional market making is now the primary economic research and engineering priority inside the single V7 architecture. Preserve PAPER-only safety. The previous rejection of unconditional generic improve1 rejects that quoting policy, not the market-making strategy class. Build one reward-aware, inventory-aware, event-driven professional maker using the canonical allocator, broker authority, ledger, monitoring and exact-SHA lifecycle. The required lifecycle remains implementation -> tests -> same-SHA PAPER -> main -> paper-validated -> deploy -> server health -> legacy deletion.

paper_v7_authorization.interpretation: 100% is a hard ceiling, not a target. Kelly, executable depth, authoritative fees, spread/slippage, inventory and unwind risk, adverse markout, capital/latency costs, state integrity and the 15% drawdown kill switch still bind. Maker cold-start PAPER exploration must use much tighter sleeve-level limits until empirical fill/markout evidence matures.

architecture.target: one slim canonical V7 PAPER codebase
architecture.recovery_after_premature_cleanup: Do not restore retired numerical generations wholesale. Port only required cutover/data/monitoring primitives into V7/common/control-plane and prove them with current V7 tests.
architecture.legacy_rule: Do not add new logic to any superseded numerical generation. Any primitive still required by V7 must live in V7/common before final retirement. Git history is the archive.

economic_objective.decision_ev: P(fill_or_joint_completion|X,a) * E[alpha_or_spread_capture-costs-adverse_markout|fill,X,a] - E[partial_or_inventory_unwind_loss|X,a] - capital_cost - latency_cost + conservatively_haircut_maker_rebate + conservatively_haircut_liquidity_reward
economic_objective.market_maker_rule: Directional alpha is not a generic prerequisite for a post-only maker quote. Optimize action-specific fill-conditioned trading PnL, maker rebates and liquidity rewards as separate components. Reward/subsidy dependence must be explicit. Allow tightly bounded PAPER exploration with zero promotion credit to solve execution-model cold start.
economic_objective.multi_leg_rule: Estimate the empirical joint completion/state distribution; product or minimum of marginal fill probabilities is not an accepted substitute.
economic_objective.success: positive forward realized PAPER fill-conditioned post-cost PnL with causal data, realistic simulated fills, authoritative fees, executable depth, inventory/unwind losses, markout, reward/rebate attribution, cost stress and no leakage

model_contracts.professional_market_maker: PRIMARY PRIORITY. Treat maker as microstructure/control, not directional alpha. Reuse shared C++ WebSocket L2 state; choose post-only JOIN/IMPROVE/FADE/ONE_SIDED/WITHDRAW by action-specific P(fill|X,a), fill-conditioned markout/toxicity, queue, OFI, imbalance, microprice, depth, cancel latency, inventory-aware reservation prices and reward/rebate context. Temporary one-sided YES/NO inventory is allowed within tight limits and must be full-depth marked/unwound; complete sets are merged/accounted explicitly. Dynamic reward-market selection is required. Maker rebates and liquidity rewards remain separate from trading PnL and receive conservative decision haircuts. Reward minimum size and queue never grant capital. Unconditional improve1 remains rejected.
model_contracts.fast_structural_arb: always-on secondary low-model-risk lane; use event-driven/local L2 state, dual exchange/receive clocks, stale/sequence continuity checks, authoritative per-market fees, executable depth, sequential leg revalidation and explicit partial/unwind accounting
model_contracts.graph_rv: secondary prospective dual-clock joint-state lane; queue ahead reduces fillability and must not grant capital; compare maker/maker, maker/taker, taker/maker, taker/taker, sequential, near-simultaneous, join, improve and cross by total executable EV; explicit partial-state unwind
model_contracts.cross_sectional_ranking: lower-priority parallel research; relative top-vs-bottom executable ranking; evaluate 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; do not pool inference across horizons; frozen holdout model is fit once strictly before holdout_start minus embargo and is never refit inside the frozen holdout; online walk-forward evidence is separate
model_contracts.micro_taker: secondary selective short-horizon complete executable round-trip target with entry ask VWAP, expected/realized exit bid VWAP, both authoritative fees, slippage, uncertainty, adverse markout and capital-time costs; open positions mark to full-depth executable liquidation net of exit fee or fail closed
model_contracts.external_intelligence: continue low-cost parallel point-in-time collection; raw external features never become a synthetic terminal probability without approved causal mapping and evidence; use as maker fair-value/toxicity context only after causal validation
model_contracts.learned_execution: critical shared service for maker and multi-leg strategies: estimate action-specific P(fill|X,a), fill-conditioned markout, cancel/replace effects and direct joint state distributions empirically from the canonical exact-SHA ledger
model_contracts.micro_maker: alias for the professional_market_maker program; the old maker-disabled interpretation is superseded. Unconditional always-improve remains rejected, but bounded PAPER exploration and EV-optimized maker quoting are authorized.
model_contracts.pca: low-priority single-leg residual statistical arbitrage only; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; no mandatory hedge basket, terminal-probability semantics or binary Kelly
model_contracts.local_factor: low-priority pair-specific panels, pair-excluded orientation-invariant factor basis, same-basis null-preserving inference, dependence-robust multiplicity, horizon-matched forecasts and explicit execution economics

rules: maker quote/cancel decisions are event-driven; maker execution_seconds are latency experiment buckets rather than required polling cadences
keep state, PnL, labels and inference separate by frequency
do not select a new frequency post hoc on the same holdout
new frequencies require prospective chronological evidence
frozen holdout evidence and adaptive walk-forward evidence must never be mixed

current_priority_order: Professional Market Making V7: primary economic system. Build dynamic rewarded-market selection, shared C++ WebSocket hot path, action-specific fill/markout learning, inventory control, complete-set accounting, reward/rebate-aware EV, bounded cold-start PAPER exploration and canonical-ledger evidence.

Maker latency: remove REST/polling from the quote/cancel hot path, react to every relevant WebSocket book update, and aggressively reduce feed/decision/cancel p50/p95/p99 tails without weakening causal/safety checks.

Maker evidence: generate many small causal PAPER quote decisions and fills, learn action-specific fill/markout/toxicity, keep exploration out of promotion credit, and optimize trading PnL plus separately reported maker rebates and liquidity rewards.
Repair any bug that invalidates economic or exact-SHA evidence or cutover safety.
Fast Structural Arb/HFT: keep always on as a secondary structural lane with strict dual-clock freshness, depth, fees, latency and partial/unwind accounting.
Graph/RV: retain as a secondary structural relative-value lane and improve empirical joint completion and total executable EV.
External Intelligence: continue point-in-time collection in parallel and investigate only causal maker fair-value/toxicity contributions.
Ranking/PCA/Local Factor/Micro Taker: preserve correctness and collect evidence, but do not consume primary engineering capacity until professional maker execution is mature.
Restore one canonical V7 monitoring/deploy/health plane and add maker trading/rebate/reward/inventory/latency observability.

After one exact V7 SHA is on main, paper-validated, deployed and server-health green, aggressively delete every remaining superseded adapter/workflow/config/test/dashboard/transitional bridge no longer imported by V7/common.
